steps: 1. Open **Mod Tweaker > Dialogue**, expand a conversation, scroll several pages, search by spoken words, and hover a long row.
2. Cycle one line through Default, Enabled, Disabled, and Default; persist a non-default state through closing the view and restarting the game.
3. Use a row's media button to play, pause, resume, and replace it with another line; confirm the progress bar advances, freezes, resumes, and resets on replacement.
4. While playing, collapse the conversation, filter the row out, change tabs, close Mod Tweaker, and change world; each edge must stop/reset preview ownership.
5. Disable every line in one small repeatable conversation and retrigger it naturally, then re-enable one line and retrigger.
6. Run `/cd_regression_test` and `/gut_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the log.
assertions: Conversation grouping, transcript search/hover, exact tri-state persistence, one-owner play/pause/progress behavior, cleanup edges, and natural-selection precedence all work. Disabled lines never play; an all-disabled conversation is suppressed; re-enabling one restores eligibility. Both regression suites pass with no startup hook error, stall, unbounded widget growth, or preview leak.
Assert tri-state toggle persists across restart; disabled line never chosen over N forced triggers; preview returns nonzero playing id and stops on every exit edge. Audibility V.
